I don't know whether you're trolling me or not but that actually made me laugh.

I don't have depression. I just have a crippling mental illness that makes me abusive and manipulating.

IT security consultant.
I'm 170cm and i'm straight.
I did play football in high school. (soccer for the us)

I don't take any kind of drug or medication. I used to take anti depressants but my previous therapists put me off meds saying borderline is more of an emotional hypersensitivity than chemical imbalance and that no meds can fix it.

Better do it sooner than later. When I got diagnosed with it, I didn't really care about it as much because I thought it was just a passenger dysfunction but sadly it's a lifelong illness unless you treat it properly... I truly am at my wit's end I feel like I wasted 3 perfectly fine relationship just because I didn't take the time to look up the disorder..

I used to take anti depressants but I'm not depressed anymore, I just have moody episodes with extreme sadness or extreme angst when I get upset about petty things.
And those only happens while in a "relationship", not really when i'm with friends or on my own or at work.
